{{Current events|year=2026|month=05|day=9|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says that he thinks the [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]] may come to an end soon after previously vowing victory over [[Ukraine]] during the [[Victory Day (9 May)|Victory Day]] [[Moscow Victory Day Parade|military parade]] in [[Moscow]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-says-he-thinks-ukraine-conflict-is-coming-an-end-2026-05-09/ (Reuters)] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/05/09/putin-says-ukraine-war-winding-down-blasts-west-for-backing-kyiv-a92723 (''The Moscow Times'')]'
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)]]
***[[Kharkiv Oblast]] [[Governor of Kharkiv Oblast|governor]] [[Oleh Syniehubov]] says that a Russian [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] has struck a residential building in [[Kharkiv]] during the beginning of the 3-day [[ceasefire]] between Russia and [[Ukraine]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/russian-drone-strikes-apartment-building-in-kharkiv-less-than-24-hours-into-ceasefire/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[2026 Mali offensives]]
***Sources say that 70 people were killed in a new wave of attacks in central [[Mali]] the previous day. [[Al-Qaeda]]-linked [[Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] claims responsibility. [https://dailybeirut.com/en/world/mali-militant-attacks-death-toll-surpasses-70/ (Daily Beirut)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/over-70-killed-in-attacks-in-mali-al-qaeda-linked-jnim-claims-responsibility/amp_articleshow/130985336.cms (''Times of India'')]
**Supporters of the [[Mali]] [[military junta]] gather in [[Bamako]] gather to reaffirm their support of [[National Transitional Council (Mali)|Transitional Council]] authorities. [https://www.africanews.com/2026/05/10/mali-hundreds-rally-to-show-support-for-beleaguered-army-leader/ (Africanews)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2026 Bannu attacks]]
***At least 21 [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|police officers]] are killed and three others are injured in a [[car bomb]], followed by gunfire and other explosions, at a checkpoint in [[Bannu]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/9/three-police-officers-killed-in-car-bomb-attack-in-northwest-pakistan (''Al Jazeera'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2026 Blue Nile campaign]]
***The [[Sudanese Army]] announces that it has seized control of the Al-Kili area in the [[Blue Nile State]] from [[Rapid Support Forces]] and [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North|SPLM–N]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/sudanese-army-announces-its-control-over-al-kili-area-in-blue-nile-state/3932614 (AA)]
*[[Ituri conflict]]
**The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|DR Congolese]] [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|military]] reports that at least 69 people were killed in an attack by [[CODECO]] in [[Ituri Province]] in April. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2642971/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[61st Venice Biennale]]
**The 61st [[Venice Biennale]] in [[Italy]] opens to the public without a jury after the jury quit in protest of [[Israel]]'s and [[Russia]]'s participation and loud protests outside their pavilions. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-venice-biennale-protests-israel-russia-760228a0f311f8fe8f8dd3487e57cc70 (AP)]
**Exhibits from over 100 countries are shown on display including [[Belgium]]. [https://www.brusselstimes.com/belgium/2122328/belgian-performance-art-on-display-at-venice-biennale (''Brussels Times'')]
*[[2026 Moscow Victory Day Parade]]
**[[Russia]] marks the [[Victory Day (9 May)|Victory Day]] with a scaled-down [[Moscow Victory Day Parade|military parade]] in [[Moscow]]. [https://news.sky.com/video/russia-holds-scaled-down-military-parade-13541925 (Sky News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four [[Mineral industry of Colombia|miners]] are found dead following an explosion at a [[coal mine]] in [[Cucunubá]], [[Ubaté Province]], [[Colombia]]. [https://citizen.digital/article/four-miners-dead-in-colombia-coal-mine-explosion-n382419 (AFP via Citizen Digital)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak]]
**[[British Army]] medics are parachuted from an [[Royal Air Force|RAF]] [[Airbus A400M Atlas|A400M]] onto the remote [[Atlantic Ocean|Atlantic]] island of [[Tristan da Cunha]] to deliver vital supplies to a British national with suspected [[Hantavirus infection|hantavirus]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgzv77ldpdo (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Arrest of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**[[Brazil]]ian [[Supreme Federal Court]] justice [[Alexandre de Moraes]] suspends the implementation of a [[Law of Brazil|law]] that could reduce prison sentences for individuals convicted over the [[2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot|2022–2023 coup plot]], including former [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]], pending a [[Constitution of Brazil|constitutional]] review by the full court. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260509-brazil-court-suspends-law-aimed-at-reducing-bolsonaro-sentence (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Bahrain]] arrests 41 individuals in connection with [[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]], including [[Shia in Bahrain|Shia]] [[Shia clergy|clerics]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/bahrain-arrests-dozens-shia-clerics-crackdown-intensifies (MENA via ''The New Arab'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Hungarian parliamentary election]]
**[[Magyar Government]]
***[[Péter Magyar]] of the [[Tisza Party]] is sworn in as the [[Prime Minister of Hungary|prime minister]] of [[Hungary]], ending the [[Hungary under Viktor Orbán|16-year tenure]] of [[Fidesz]]'s [[Viktor Orbán]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/magyar-sworn-hungarys-prime-minister-promises-change-2026-05-09/ (Reuters)]
**The [[National Assembly (Hungary)|National Assembly]] of Hungary reconvenes for the first time since the election as elected [[List of members of the National Assembly of Hungary (2026–2030)|members]] are sworn in. [[Ágnes Forsthoffer]] is elected as [[List of speakers of the National Assembly (Hungary)|speaker]]. [https://bbj.hu/politics/domestic/parliament/agnes-forsthoffer-elected-speaker-only-2nd-woman-to-hold-role/ (''Budapest Business Journal'')]
*[[2026 Farrer by-election]]
**[[Division of Farrer|Farrer]] [[Member of parliament|MP]] [[David Farley (politician)|David Farley]] becomes the first [[One Nation]] candidate elected to the [[Australian House of Representatives]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-05-09/farrer-sat-night-results/106656856 (ABC News Australia)]
